verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs show two bulk mechanisms. The custom objects API supports retrieving records "individually or in batches," and the import tool can "add or update data across different objects" in one operation, including creating associations. However, the only programmatic batch capability evidenced is retrieval, and import is file-based rather than an AI- or API-driven bulk action. Missing for 10: documented batch create/update/delete API endpoints, bulk edit/delete of records, bulk actions via the MCP server or AI agents, independent/hands-on corroboration.
